caption: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with tender chashu pork and vibrant green scallions. Served in a patterned bowl, it rests on a pink surface under soft, even lighting, with a small white cup nearby.

segments_info.text: The surface is smooth, pinkish-red, with subtle texture and faint white lines near the edges.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with a slightly glossy surface and irregular, soft edges.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy, golden-brown, and glossy, with visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
White ceramic bowl with colorful geometric and floral patterns along its rim.
